description: Planned EdgeConneX campus of seven buildings in Skellefteå with 672–1,050 MW of site power by early 2031. The first two buildings, with 192–300 MW, are targeted for early 2028 and have building permission. No investment decision for the full campus and no signed phased power supply have been confirmed.

Brookfield proposes an AI data centre in Strängnäs of about 750 MW, expanded from an earlier 300 MW plan. The sources do not state whether the figure is IT or site power. Power supply, final size and schedule are unresolved.

EcoDataCenter campus at Kvarnsveden in Borlänge with an undated potential of up to 600 MW of site power. Three halls of 12 MW IT each are under construction, and the first customers, including Mistral AI, are targeted for spring 2027. An initial grid supply of 250 MW is planned.

Planned atNorth campus of up to 300 MW of site power at Hamre Industrial Park in Långsele. First operation is targeted for autumn 2028, with an initial grid connection of 200 MW. Capacity per building and phasing have not been published.
Former HPC plan at Marviken in Norrköping with up to 300 MW. EdgeMode has withdrawn from the development. The project is kept as history and adds no future capacity.
EcoDataCenter decided in September 2025 not to proceed with the Östersund project, which was planned for up to 150 MW of grid capacity. The project is kept as history and adds no future capacity.
atNorth facility in Akalla, Stockholm, with 30 MW of site power. Earthworks were under way in 2026, and first operation is targeted for the fourth quarter of 2027.
Conapto facility in Sollentuna with 28 MW of IT power within a 40 MW power feed. The full IT capacity is contracted for delivery in July 2027. The operator gives a design PUE of about 1.15.

Mistral AI is the customer in hall B3 of the EcoDataCenter campus in Borlänge and has announced 23 MW of AI infrastructure. The hall is described as 12 MW of IT power, so the two figures do not match. The capacity is part of the Borlänge campus and is not counted twice.
Evroc is building an 18 MW AI data centre at Arlandastad, targeted for the second half of 2026. The sources do not state whether the figure is IT or site power.
Conapto has completed an 8 MW expansion of Stockholm 4 South, which raised the site from 20 to 28 MW. The expansion is in operation.
ScandiDC facility in Eskilstuna with 10 MW of site power. The first phase of up to 6 MW IT is under construction, with customer move-in targeted for late 2026.
GlobalConnect is expanding an existing facility in southern Stockholm by 1.2 MW to 2.7 MW in total. Launch is targeted for 2026.

Google data centre site at Horndal in Avesta. The county administrative board estimates about 500 MW for a plan of up to five halls, based on backup generator sizing. The first facility has been under construction since 2026 and is targeted for 2028, but Google has not disclosed its capacity.

Google data centre in Skien. Construction started in 2024, and the first phase has been allocated 240 MW of grid capacity. Google still lists the site as in development, so the original 2026 operating target is not treated as met.
Operating Green Mountain campus at Heggvin in Hamar. The first three buildings have 90 MW of IT power, and the operator describes a campus of up to 150 MW IT.

Operating Green Mountain campus in Enebakk with 26.8 MW of power in operation. The operator describes up to about 93 MW of site power and 75 MW of IT power at full build-out, without a confirmed date.

Operating Green Mountain facility in Rjukan with 6.7 MW of power in operation. The operator markets up to 50 MW of IT power. An expected expansion to 43.7 MW in 2025 has not been confirmed as operating.

Operating Green Mountain mountain-hall facility at Rennesøy near Stavanger with 16.5 MW of power in operation. The operator expects up to 29 MW of site power by 2029 and markets up to 25 MW of IT power.
Operating underground campus in Stad with 80 MW of available grid power. The operator gives a full campus potential of up to 200 MW.

Bulk campus in Kristiansand. A new 42 MW IT facility has been under construction since January 2024. The wider campus potential of up to 1,000 MW of site power and a 700 MW grid reservation have no investment decision.

Possible Green Mountain campus at Kalberg in Time, separate from the Undheim site. A plan of up to 250 MW for eight buildings has been described, without stating whether this is IT or site power. Only non-binding customer interest has been reported.
Green Mountain project of about 120 MW of site power at Vagle in Sandnes. The project stopped after the municipal council did not approve the required plan change.

Borealis campus at Renforsin Ranta in Kajaani, where a 10 MW facility was completed in 2025. Borealis advertises a further expansion of more than 100 MW, without a date. The site is separate from the Borealis project at Otanmäki.

project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Espoo campus
description: Microsoft cloud campus in Espoo. The environmental assessment gives 172.8 MW of IT power and 211.4 MW of total electrical capacity. Construction of the first phase began in late 2024. Microsoft has not announced commissioning or investment in the full campus.

project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Kirkkonummi campus
description: Microsoft cloud campus in Kirkkonummi. The environmental assessment gives 144 MW of IT power and 175.8 MW of total electrical capacity. The first building, with 48 MW IT, has been under construction since late 2024 and is targeted for 2028.

project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Vihti campus
description: Microsoft cloud campus in Vihti. The environmental assessment gives 192 MW of IT power and 234.4 MW of total electrical capacity. The first building, with 48 MW IT, has been under construction since late 2024 and is targeted for 2028.
Google has operated the Hamina campus since 2011. It bought more land in September 2026 for a possible expansion but has not disclosed its capacity or schedule.

Data centre under construction in Kouvola for Hyperco, with about 64 MW of electrical capacity. Construction started in October 2025 and is due for completion in May 2027. A 100 MW IT figure reported for the area belongs to the separate western Hiivuri project.
DayOne campus in Lahti with 128 MW of IT power and a 180 MW grid connection. Construction of the first 50 MW IT building began in 2026, with first operation targeted for 2027.

atNorth site in Espoo where a new building has been under construction since April 2026, due in autumn 2027. Total capacity after the expansion is 45 MW of site power. The existing capacity is unknown, so the size of the addition is uncertain.

Planned atNorth campus at Myllykoski in Kouvola with up to 430 MW of site power. YIT is building individual buildings, with the first targeted for commissioning by the end of 2027. Building capacities are undisclosed, and investment in the full campus is not confirmed.
Nebius AI campus in Mäntsälä with 75 MW in operation. A second 70 MW building and a dedicated substation were announced in October 2026. The substation is due in autumn 2027.

Nebius AI campus at Pajarila in Lappeenranta with 310 MW of site power. The first phase is under construction and targeted for 2027, but its capacity is undisclosed. A 350 MW grid connection is listed for the site.
Verne campus in Mäntsälä, separate from the Nebius site. Construction of the first 70 MW, described as grid connection capacity, was confirmed in June 2026. No operation date has been given.

project_name: XTX Markets Kajaani data centre complex
description: XTX Markets data centre complex in Kajaani. The first building has 22.5 MW of IT power and a 2026 target. YIT is also building the second and third buildings, whose capacities are undisclosed.

New LUMI-AI facility for CSC in Kajaani, under construction with operation targeted for 2027. No electrical rating has been published. A heat study uses 30 MW, but CSC states that power will be set through procurement.

EcoDataCenter campus plan at Röbacken in Smedjebacken with a 150 MW envelope. The municipality reports a positive indication for 150 MW of grid supply in 2028–2030. Construction may start in early 2027 if permits are granted, and first operation is targeted for 2029.

Planned EcoDataCenter colocation campus at Norrsundet in Gävle with about 150 MW of electrical demand. A September 2026 consultation describes development in stages over about ten years. No investment decision or dated grid allocation has been published.

Google campus plan at Torsboda in Timrå. The municipality gives an initial 650 MW phase to be completed by the end of 2030, a 1,000 MW power goal and a possible later campus of up to 2,000 MW. An appeal of the land sale was unresolved in October 2026, and no construction or investment decision has been confirmed.
Green Mountain is building two data centre buildings at Undheim in Time, with 80 MW of IT power within up to 100 MW of site power. Full completion is scheduled for 2028.

EdgeConneX campus of six buildings at Molandsmoen in Fyresdal. Construction began in the first quarter of 2026. The planned grid envelope of 365 MW consists of 140 MW allocated and 225 MW in the Statnett queue.
BW Velora has a site agreement at Frier Vest in Bamble for a data centre of around 250 MW. The capacity measure, financing, phasing and commissioning are unresolved.

Nscale campus at Kvandal in Narvik, also known as Stargate Norway. Three buildings totalling 100 MW are under construction within a campus with expected electricity consumption of 230 MW. A further 290 MW of grid withdrawal is in the Statnett reservation queue.

Planning-approved Green Horizon data centre at Kviamarka in Hå, with 30 MW of IT power within 36 MW of power capacity. The target PUE is 1.1, and ready-for-service is targeted for the second half of 2027.

Microsoft has bought the Kvål site in Sandnes and announced a new cloud region. Microsoft has stated a capacity of 25 MW without defining the measure. No construction start or commissioning year has been published.
Nscale and Løvenskiold-Fossum hold a land purchase option at Bolvik in Skien and have applied for 576 MW of grid capacity. The option depends on zoning and power access.
WS Computing, linked to Google, has a site agreement at Gylderåsen in Våler and a reported grid request of 480 MW. Google has not announced a construction decision or operating date.
atNorth site of 36 hectares in Haugaland Business Park, Tysvær. The campus is designed for 350 MW of site power, with an initial 120 MW phase and power expected in 2028.
Asp has municipal approval to buy a site at Tysingvatnet in Suldal for a phased data centre. The municipality states at least 25 MW of grid withdrawal, and the site potential is up to 100 MW.

New Polar facility in Drangedal next to its existing 12 MW site. NVE has granted a concession for up to 55 MW of grid withdrawal, and Polar describes about 40 MW of IT power. No commissioning date has been found.

Polar AI and HPC redevelopment at Herøya in Porsgrunn, with 41 MW of IT power within 100 MW of total capacity and a target PUE of 1.12. The zoning amendment took effect in March 2026, but construction has not been confirmed.
Bulk has acquired a municipal site at Longum Nord in Arendal and aims for 150 MW of grid capacity by the end of 2029. No construction decision has been published.
Lefdal Mine Data Centers plans a new facility at Moskog in Sunnfjord with an operational stage of 80 MW. The capacity measure and commissioning year are not stated.
Nscale is the proponent of the approved data centre plan at Korgen in Hemnes. The Statnett queue shows 250 MW requested for 2028, and Nscale has reportedly requested a further 750 MW.
Forsand DC is preparing a detailed zoning plan and impact assessment at Myra in Sandnes for a facility of about 50 MW. No construction decision has been published.
Terakraft has converted the former Sauda I hydropower station into an AI data centre with 10 MW of site power. Commissioning and full-load testing were reported in July 2026.

WS Computing, owned by Google, has reportedly applied for a 360 MW grid connection at North Sea Energy Park in Bjerkreim. No construction decision, allocation or commissioning date has been published.
VivoPower plans a 40 MW expansion of its Mo i Rana facility, which has 41.5 MW in operation. The expansion could be energised in 2027–2028, subject to approval.
Magnora and Blix plan an AI and edge data centre at Nedre Rommen 5 in Oslo. Initial power access is 1 MW, and studies indicate up to 9 MW subject to grid, cooling and structural limits.

Green Horizon and Wiig Gartneri plan a permitted 4 MW data centre at Orre in Klepp, with waste heat used in the greenhouse. Two MW is available at the site, and the full 4 MW requires a new power cable. The project is waiting for a customer.
Storespeed operates about 1 MW in Halden and has applied for grid capacity to expand to up to 5 MW within the existing premises.
Blix NR5 at Nedre Rommen 5 in Oslo has 2 MW installed and infrastructure for 3 MW in total, which leaves 1 MW of possible new capacity.

Planned atNorth campus in Salo with 230 MW of site power and up to 160 MW of IT power. The first phase has 75 MW of secured supply and 60 MW of IT power, with power available from the third quarter of 2028.

Microsoft campus across Vaasa and Mustasaari. Land agreements and preparatory works are reported, but the electrical capacity and commissioning dates are unknown. The only published power figure is 295 MW of backup fuel input, which is not data centre load.

Google project in Kajaani with no published electrical capacity or operation date. In October 2026 the authority requested a halt to significant preparatory works until the environmental assessment is complete. A third-party figure of 176 MW IT has not been verified.

Google project in Muhos with no published electrical capacity or operation date. In October 2026 the authority requested a halt to significant preparatory works until the environmental assessment is complete.

Google campus plan of four buildings in Vaala. The September 2026 environmental assessment programme gives a theoretical maximum of up to 830 MW and normal demand of about 360 MW. Construction of the first building is planned from 2028, with operation in late 2029.
Hyperco project on an 11-hectare site in western Hiivuri, Kouvola, with 100 MW of IT power and 130 MW of total electrical capacity. Construction and operation dates are unknown.
Borealis holds a planning reservation at Otanmäki in Kajaani. Capacity and commissioning are unknown.

Operating EcoDataCenter campus in Falun. The annual report gives 41 MW in operation at the end of 2025 and 65 MW after halls E and F, targeted for 2026. The technical page lists 80 MW of available site power.

developer: Barings; unnamed global data center operator
description: Additional 30 MW of grid power under development at the Vanda 3 property in Kista, which has an existing data centre tenant. Grid works are under way, but commissioning is undated.

Bahnhof's new underground facility at Bunkeberget in Gothenburg. The first hall, with 1 MW of electrical demand, is targeted for the first quarter of 2027. The full facility has up to 12 MW of site power, without a date.

HIVE plans to convert its Big Boden mining site to HPC, using the existing 32 MW power supply with about 25 MW of IT power. No additional grid capacity is claimed, and the letter of intent is non-binding.

Microsoft is expanding its Ersbo site in Gävle with additional halls. A 2022 permit estimates site demand of about 60 MW after the expansion. Capacity and operation dates for the new halls are undisclosed.

Microsoft is expanding its Stackbo site in Gävle with additional halls. A 2022 permit estimates site demand of about 60 MW after the expansion. Capacity and operation dates for the new halls are undisclosed.

Microsoft is expanding its Tuna site in Sandviken with additional halls. No capacity or operation dates for the new halls have been published. The only published figure is backup combustion capacity, which is not data centre load.
Conapto facility in Sollentuna with 6 MW of total power, including existing operation. A 1.2 MW expansion started in the second quarter of 2026.
Planned underground ScandiDC facility of 1–5 MW of site power. Location and operation date have not been disclosed.
ScandiDC development concept for AI and HPC. Location, capacity and schedule have not been disclosed.
ScandiDC development concept for hyperscale and AI use. Location, capacity and schedule have not been disclosed.
Bahnhof has discontinued the Elementica development in Norra Djurgårdsstaden and put the site up for sale. The project is kept as history and adds no future capacity.
Tekniska verken is building a 1.5 MW colocation facility at Mjärdevi in Linköping. The operator targets first customer access in late 2027, and works are planned from October 2026 to June 2028.
Pure DC campus in Seinäjoki. The first 110 MW IT phase is fully leased and under development. The wider campus could exceed 550 MW of IT power, subject to further permits and contracts.
Compute Nordic campus at Visulahti in Mikkeli for Cerebras, with 165 MW of contracted IT power. The first 50 MW of IT power is under construction.

developer: Prime Data Centers / Data Prop Link Oy
description: Prime Data Centers project at Emalikatu in Järvenpää with alternative designs of 100 and 130 MW of IT power. Construction is planned from 2027.
QTS campus of 150 hectares at Ratasmäki in Forssa. The environmental assessment gives 324–702 MW of IT power across alternative layouts. First operation is targeted for 2031.
AmpTank and Data Tank Nordic data centre of about 200 MW in Utajärvi. Preparatory works are confirmed, but full construction remains conditional. The capacity measure is not stated.
Nscale has a site development agreement at Sievari in Harjavalta. Nscale states that total power is still to be determined, and a third-party figure of 100 MW has not been verified.
Planned DayOne campus at Sudentulli in Nurmijärvi with up to 560 MW of grid power. Commissioning and secured supply are unconfirmed.
FCDC site at Kuriirintie 7 in Vaasa with 250 MW of connection capacity. FCDC lists construction as ongoing, and the municipality targets first operation in 2028–2029.
Proposed data centre at the former Kaipola paper mill in Jämsä, with 200 MW initially and 600 MW in total. The capacity measure is not stated, and the construction start is unconfirmed.

Hyperco project at Virkkala in Lohja, with alternative designs of 133–400 MW of total power and 100–300 MW of IT power. Piling began in 2026, and first operation is targeted for 2027. The capacity of the first phase is undisclosed.

Hyperco campus at Eastern Junction in Loviisa. Earthworks are under way, with first operation targeted for late 2027. No capacity has been published, and a reported 250 MW figure has not been verified.
Planned QTS campus at Jokela in Tuusula with 96 MW of IT power in two buildings. Construction is planned from 2027.
FCDC plans three halls at Bäljars in Raasepori, with about 100 MW of electrical power according to the local utility. Construction was planned for 2026, but the start has not been confirmed.
Arcem development at Huutokoski in Joroinen. Arcem gives 60 MW potentially available in 2027, rising to 100 MW in 2029, and a campus potential of 500 MW.

project_name: ASP DC Pori Copper Industrial Park
developer: ASP DC / former CompassForge Real Estate I
description: ASP campus of 37 hectares at the Copper Industrial Park in Pori, with 90 MW of secured supply and up to 320 MW available. The service target is 2028.
Planned FCDC campus of five buildings at Jokilaakso in Kerava with 250 MW of electrical capacity. First operation is targeted for 2028–2029, and later stages are conditional.
New GleSYS campus with Trevian in Oulu. The first phase of about 8 MW IT is targeted for autumn 2026. Expansion to 300 MW is described as long-term potential.
Bitzero campus in Kokemäki with a stated potential of 1 GW. A first phase of 80 MW is described for 2027, and the technical page gives 55 MW of near-term supply. The order of these steps is unclear.

Hyperco plan for four or ten halls at Keskikylä in Pyhäjoki, with 369–884 MW of site power across the alternative designs. Preparatory earthworks are reported, but hall construction and investment are unconfirmed.
Nova Complex project at Kymin Ruukki in Kouvola, with a building permit. The first data centre of 40 MW is targeted for the first half of 2027. The capacity measure is not stated.
Borealis has a reported municipal land reservation at Ruskonselkä in Oulu. The plan gives at least 30 MW initially and 100 MW or more in total, without an operation date.
FCDC project at Visulahti in Mikkeli. A municipal decision of February 2026 confirms 250 MW and a building permit. Phasing, investment decision and dates are undisclosed.
Regant project at Visulahti in Mikkeli, with 50 MW under planning according to a municipal document of February 2026. Phasing, investment decision and dates are unknown.
Planned FCDC development at Mahlianmaa in Valkeakoski. Zoning is confirmed, but capacity and commissioning are unknown.
Asp facility at Kanalvegen 11 in Sola. A second phase of up to 6 MW IT is contracted from the third quarter of 2027. The site has a gross power specification of up to 11 MW.
Asp facility at Midtgårdveien 12 in Stavanger, where site power is set to grow from 9 to 12 MW. The 3 MW expansion has no date or investment decision.

developer: Aurora Core Technology / 3 E Network / Orka Technologies
description: Aurora Core AI project at the Pellos industrial site in Mikkeli. The site was leased in December 2025, and the permit was confirmed in April 2026. An initial 6 MW phase and a wider connection potential of 50 MW are described.
FCDC has a building permit for a data centre at Akaa. No capacity, investment decision or commissioning date has been disclosed.

Bitzero and Exanorth site at Tunnsjødal in Namsskogan with 40 MW in operation. An expansion to 110 MW of site power is targeted for customer readiness in 2027–2028, and the site potential is up to 300 MW.
Exanorth and Bitzero development at Storhaugen in Røyrvik, with up to 20 MW of growth potential and 5 MW of available power. No construction or energisation date has been confirmed.
Microsoft has bought land and started planning for server halls at Benkammen 14 in Fosieby, Malmö. No capacity, operation date or investment decision has been published.
Verda plans an AI data centre at Almåsen and Töva in Sundsvall, based on municipal planning. No site capacity or delivery date has been published.
Roofscapes and Vostroblock plan an AI and HPC expansion next to an existing site in Bräcke, after a municipal land sale in October 2026. No capacity or delivery date has been verified.
Hyperco plans a data centre at Vallhalla near Lingbo in Ockelbo. The land-use plan was adopted in June 2026, and the first hall is targeted for November 2027. Its capacity is unknown.
Fossefall plans an AI platform on about 35 hectares north of Jokkmokk, with a first stage of 45 MW and up to 200 MW in total. Construction of the first stage is planned around 2027.

developer: Vertical Data Nordic AB; Vertical Data Inc.
description: Vertical Data Nordic has a conditional agreement to buy an existing 4.5 MW industrial data centre at Hamre Industrial Park in Sollefteå and is applying for up to 100 MW in total. No closing or investment decision has been confirmed.

developer: Vantage Data Centers; VDC ARN Power AB
description: Vantage plans a data centre on about 400 hectares near Mehedeby in Tierp, after a positive municipal planning notice. No site capacity, investment decision or construction start has been confirmed, and grid supply is unresolved.
Panattoni has a non-binding reservation of 20 hectares in Hässleholm for a 300 MW hyperscale facility. A supply indication of 150 MW around 2033 is not a contract, and the tenant is unannounced.
Genesis Digital Assets has bought municipal land next to its existing data centre in Porjus for an AI and HPC expansion. No additional capacity or date has been verified.

Panattoni has a municipal land reservation of 14 hectares in Tuna, Sandviken, north of the Microsoft site. It has applied for 250 MW of grid power, possibly available in 2031, and targets construction of the first hall in 2029.
